title: SPLA/102/2014 of Pankaj Kumar Sachdeva Vs Vijay Hudiya AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
SPLA No.102 of 2014
With
CRLA no.218 of 2014
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.

Heard Mr. M.K. Ray, Advocate for the
applicant.
 Present criminal appeal along with
special leave to appeal has been preferred
against the judgment and order dated
23.6.2014 passed by Special Judicial
Magistrate, Rudrapur, District Udham
Singh Nagar in criminal case no.612 of
2013, whereby respondent has been
acquitted from the charge leveled against
him under Section 138 of N.I. Act.
 Leave is granted. Application made,
therefor, stands allowed.
 Admit the appeal.
 Issue fresh notice to the respondents,
wherefor, learned counsel for the appellant
shall take steps within a week.
 List after service report is received.
